evidence.quote: I want your read on it from the rota side before it hardens.

observations.why: Tanya explicitly invites Freya into shaping the operational plan prior to finalizing it.

evidence.quote: A cutover night pulls four of my supervisors out of the normal rota
Two cutovers in the same week means eight of eleven are on cutover duty

observations.why: Freya influences sequencing decisions by laying out precise staffing arithmetic and operational facts.

evidence.quote: I'm telling you it's arithmetic. One site at a time is the only sequencing my rota can actually produce people for.

observations.why: Freya frames the argument as unyielding numerical reality based on her domain expertise over rota management.
Xavier explicitly ratifies Freya's logical argument as an unyielding structural constraint over speculative risk arguments.

evidence.quote: Xavier, anything from your side that changes?

observations.why: Tanya consults technical stakeholder Xavier to verify system rules against the proposed sequencing.

evidence.quote: The replica rule and the reference-data rule both assume one cutover window open at a time

evidence.quote: Freya, what do you need from me?

observations.why: Tanya asks directly for operational requirements and constraints from the rota owner.

evidence.quote: a commitment that a soak doesn't get shortened because a date slipped.

observations.why: Freya conditions operational feasibility on a hard managerial commitment regarding schedule integrity.

evidence.quote: That's fair and I'll hold it.
